title: Alligator Reef Boat Rentals (Formerly Sand Dollar)

services.name: Sunset cruise
services.desc: A private, captained sunset cruise from Breezy Palms marina in Islamorada. The captain runs the boat the whole trip, you bring food and drinks. No license, no orientation, no setup. We push off at 6:00 PM and return to the dock by 8:30. Florida Keys waters into the Gulf of America for the Golden Hour. The cruise leaves the marina at 6:00 PM and runs about two and a half hours. The captain picks the route based on the wind and where the sky is firing that night. Most nights that means a slow loop south into the Florida Keys waters and west into the Gulf of America for the actual sunset, then back to the dock by 8:30. It's a private trip.
